summary: Every material solver-visible obligation in instruction.md and the referenced /app/sovereign-lb/docs contracts maps to meaningful native behavior exercised by the verifier, and all 32 pytest probes (28 F2P / 4 P2P) are discoverable from that contract surface. Authority, rollout, canonical digests, TCP streaming, readiness, protocol rejection, eligibility, and checkpoint recovery are bidirectionally aligned. Residual gaps are advisory only: least-connections selection, explicit drain deadlines, passive ejection, audit export, and timeout teardown are documented but not individually probed.

evidence.observation: Twenty concise bullets state the complete engineering work request: canonical validation, revision/idempotency fencing, immutable snapshots, control protocol, quorum rollout, TCP proxy semantics, eligibility, PROXY v2, checkpoint recovery, bounded observability, and lab constraints.
Binding desired-state schema for listeners, target groups, targets, health, rollout quorum, limits, and canonical ordering referenced by instruction.
Length-prefixed envelope semantics for hello/prepare/prepared/rejected/activate/active/status referenced by instruction.
Prepare/activate phases, quorum on connected sessions, and last-known-good preservation semantics.
Checkpoint padding, CURRENT pointer fallback, and torn-frame rejection semantics.

32 behavioral pytest cases drive real control-plane HTTP apply, dataplane TCP forwarding, rollout status, readiness, metrics, eligibility, and restart recovery without embedding a callable end-to-end solver.
Classification-only map: 28 F2P behavioral cases and 4 P2P preservation probes across nine requirement families.
Oracle run after solution/repair.py: 32/32 pass at d7a001a9.
Starter run: 10 F2P fail / 22 pass (4 P2P), demonstrating behavioral discrimination.

findings.criterion: least_connections balancing policy is documented but not individually probed.
findings.why_it_matters: Round-robin and source-hash selection are exercised; least-connections remains discoverable from configuration.md but lacks a dedicated behavioral probe.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional holdout fixture selecting two backends with different active connection counts.

findings.criterion: Drain deadline and deregistration stop-new-assignment semantics are not directly graded.
findings.why_it_matters: Instruction and dataplane docs require drain ownership; verifier infers eligibility and rollout but does not time-bound a draining target transition.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional drain-timeout probe with administratively draining target and owned connection.

findings.criterion: Passive health ejection window is documented without a dedicated failure probe.
findings.why_it_matters: Active health and eligibility combinations are graded; passive ejection remains a delegated contract without an isolated behavioral case.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional passive-failure lab scenario after oracle repair.

findings.criterion: Audit ring export is described in observability docs but not behaviorally asserted.
findings.why_it_matters: Bounded metrics and readiness/status are graded; audit history retention is operational documentation only.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional audit endpoint cardinality probe if exposed in starter.
